# ProgressBar

Progress when it can be measured (uploads, imports, multi-step onboarding) or an indeterminate sweep for a page-level wait.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.ProgressBar` · Status

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.ProgressBar />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.ProgressBar"></x-import>
```

## Notes

role=progressbar with aria-valuenow; brand gradient fill, pill track on `--surface-skeleton`.

## Props (ProgressBarProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | Current value; omit for an indeterminate sweep. |
| `max` | `number` | @default 100 |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` | Text above the bar; also the accessible name. |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | Show the rounded percentage at inline-end. @default false |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | 4px or 8px tall. @default "md" |
| `tone` | `'brand' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | @default "brand" |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>._
